Legal

Refund Policy

Last updated: October 2026.

All sales are final

Our products are instantly downloadable digital files. Once a file is delivered, it cannot be "returned" the way a physical item can — there is no way to give back access to something already copied to your device. For that reason, all sales are final and we do not offer refunds for change of mind, duplicate purchases made in error excepted (see below).

We provide a free demo of the planner so you can evaluate it fully before buying. Please try the demo first — it exists precisely so you never need a refund.

Exceptions

  • Duplicate charges: if you were charged twice for the same order, contact us and we will refund the duplicate.
  • Defective files: if the downloaded files are corrupt or do not work as described and we cannot fix or re-deliver them within a reasonable time, we will refund the purchase.

How to request an exception refund

Email info.cosmicragsltd@gmail.com with your order details and a description of the problem. Approved refunds are issued to the original payment method.

Please note

  • Our payment processor acts as the Merchant of Record for your purchase. Under their seller terms they may issue a refund within 60 days of purchase to prevent a chargeback, even where our policy above would not grant one.
  • For buyers in the EU/UK: by completing a purchase of instantly delivered digital content you expressly consent to immediate delivery and acknowledge that you lose the 14-day right of withdrawal once download begins, as permitted by applicable law.
  • Nothing in this policy limits statutory rights that cannot be waived under your local law. Where the law requires a different outcome, the law prevails.

Chargebacks

If something is wrong, please contact us first — most issues (a broken download link, a duplicate charge) are resolved within a day. Filing a payment dispute without contacting us slows everything down and incurs dispute fees.
